notes.title: Kittenship Care Demo Now Live & Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



We’re so excited to finally share the Kittenship Care demo with you! Starting today, you can jump in and get a first taste of what it’s like to foster rescue kittens, build trust, and create a cozy, personalized space for your furry guests.



Even more exciting,  we’re thrilled to announce that Kittenship Care will officially launch on August 8th!



This demo gives you a peek into the heart of the game:

Bond with quirky kittens

Clean up tiny messes

Decorate your space to suit your furry friends

And get them ready to find their forever homes



We’d love to hear what you think! Feel free to leave feedback, share your favorite moments, or even tell us about your own foster/adoption stories.



Thanks so much for all the love and support so far. This game means the world to us, and we’re so happy you’re here with us on the journey.



See you August 8th!

– The Kittenship Care Team 🐾
